title: The Jumper
summary: The flea, the grasshopper, and the skipjack (made of a goose-bone) held a grand jumping contest before the king to win the princess's hand in marriage....
full_text:
The flea, the grasshopper, and the skipjack (made of a goose-bone) held a grand jumping contest before the king to win the princess's hand in marriage.

The flea jumped so high that no one could see where he went, so the court claimed he hadn't jumped at all. The grasshopper jumped right into the king's face, so he was disqualified for ill manners.

The quiet skipjack hopped modestly forward, landing straight into the lap of the princess!

"That is the highest jump of all!" declared the king. "To jump into the lap of my daughter shows true discretion and judgment!"

The skipjack married the princess, while the flea enlisted in a foreign army, and the grasshopper sat in the ditch, chirping that worldly prizes are given by nepotism rather than merit.
moral: Direct action aimed at the true goal triumphs over theatrical leaps into thin air.
